text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمْ ۙ إِن فِى صُدُورِهِمْ إِلَّا كِبْرٌۭ مَّا هُم بِبَٰلِغِيهِ ۚ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ

words.gloss_range: emphatic opening particle governing the long diagnostic assertion

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negative particle in the later restrictive motive clause
exceptive particle completing the restrictive motive clause
negative particle introducing the non-attainment verdict
final emphatic resumption grounding the refuge command

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens with assertion, so the disputants are not introduced neutrally. Its governing force gathers the long relative profile under a judgment before the motive is named. The later restrictions, {{ar:إِن}} ({{tr:in}}) with {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) and then {{ar:مَّا}} ({{tr:mā}}), make that certainty unfold into only pride and no attainment. The final {{ar:إِنَّهُۥ}} ({{tr:innahu}}) answers this opening frame by enclosing human polemic within divine hearing and seeing.

topics.headline: Asserted diagnostic frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusation is asserted and grammatically governed from the first word, before the inner motive is exposed.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the particle as opening the main emphatic clause over the relative profile.

topics.headline: Certainty moving toward restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a sequence from asserted accusation to restricted motive and denied attainment.
topics.reason: The later restrictive and negated clauses are syntactically tied into the opening assertion.

topics.headline: Opening and closing certainty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human polemic is enclosed between the opening certainty and the final certainty about divine perception.
topics.reason: The final emphatic frame resumes Allah after the refuge command and answers the opening frame.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun forming an accused class through its following action

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: relative-clause verb defining the group by disputation

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) makes a class through what follows: the people are known here by disputing, not by name or lineage. Masculine plural agreement ties the pronoun to {{ar:يُجَٰدِلُونَ}} ({{tr:yujādilūna}}), keeping the action from floating as a general topic. The same group then receives the missing-warrant clause, the chest diagnosis, and the non-attainment verdict. A pronoun becomes a full forensic profile.

topics.headline: Class defined by action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group is identified by ongoing disputation rather than by name or lineage.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is governed by the opening particle and completed by the following plural verb.

topics.headline: One group through the whole profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one accused group carried through public action, missing warrant, hidden motive, and failed aim.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence keeps the relative profile, motive clause, and non-attainment verdict inside one diagnostic frame.

words.gloss_range: ongoing Form III plural disputation within the sphere of Allah's signs
words.root_gloss_range: twisting, contention, and reciprocal disputation; here narrowed to polemical contest, not private doubt

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: prepositional sign-domain governed by the dispute verb
lack-of-authority phrase qualifying the dispute

words.prose: {{ar:يُجَٰدِلُونَ}} ({{tr:yujādilūna}}) is ongoing Form III plural contest, not a one-off question. The verb works through {{ar:فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِ}} ({{tr:fī āyāti}}), placing the dispute inside a sign-domain before the phrase {{ar:بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَٰنٍ}} ({{tr:bi-ghayri sulṭānin}}) collapses its legitimacy. The {{ar:ج د ل}} ({{tr:j-d-l}}) field adds twisting and entangling pressure, while the local form keeps the selected sense as polemical disputation. The formula reprises 40:35 and adds the motive in the chest; even the long-vowel chain across dispute, signs, authority, and attainment carries the ayah's pressure over reach.

topics.headline: Dispute inside a sign-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb enters the domain of signs before the ayah exposes its lack of authority.
topics.reason: The verb is completed by a prepositional domain rather than a direct object, and the warrant denial follows it.

topics.headline: Ongoing reciprocal contest
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an ongoing group practice of adversarial exchange, not a single question or private doubt.
topics.reason: The imperfect plural and Form III evidence support sustained reciprocal contention by the relative group.

topics.headline: Twisting pressure in polemic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that dispute is pictured as entangling pressure on signs, while the local form still selects polemical disputation.
topics.reason: The root image supports entangling contention, but local Form III and syntax keep the sense within dispute rather than every twisting branch.

topics.headline: Same-surah reprise with motive added
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 40:56 reprises the dispute-without-authority formula from 40:35 and adds the chest-level engine of pride.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give a concrete same-surah formula at 40:35, and this ayah supplies the interior diagnosis.

topics.headline: Long-vowel reach pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a sound-level thread carrying the contest over reach, authority, and failed attainment.
topics.reason: The row is phonological rather than lexical, but it is concrete and tied to repeated long-vowel surfaces in the local sequence.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the sign-field as the domain of dispute

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later interior prepositional phrase paired with the first sign-domain phrase

words.prose: {{ar:فِىٓ}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes the signs the field in which disputation operates. The preposition avoids treating the signs as a conquered direct object and instead marks trespass into a domain. Because the ayah later says {{ar:فِى صُدُورِهِمْ}} ({{tr:fī ṣudūrihim}}), this first {{ar:فِىٓ}} ({{tr:fī}}) prepares a movement from public sign-field to private motive-space.

topics.headline: Preposition as sign-domain marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dispute operates in the sphere of signs rather than seizing them as an object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the preposition govern the signs as the sphere of the verb.

topics.headline: Outer field answered by inner field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first sign-domain preposition preparing the later interior preposition over their chests.
topics.reason: The repeated preposition links the public arena of signs with the private motive-location.

words.gloss_range: plural construct signs, verses, and evidences governed as the disputed domain
words.root_gloss_range: sign, marker, proof, revealed unit, and disputed refuge-related derivation; here centered on divine proof-bearing signs

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: authority and warrant contrasted with the proof-bearing sign field

words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَٰتِ}} ({{tr:āyāti}}) is a genitive plural construct, so the contested field is multiple and already bound to Allah. The sign-family keeps proof, visible marker, and revealed verse in play, while the local phrase remains the broad field of Allah's signs rather than one isolated branch. The contested derivation can add refuge-like irony: they enter a sign-field polemically instead of returning in submission. The field is measured against missing {{ar:سُلْطَٰن}} ({{tr:sulṭān}}), and 41:53 helps show how resistance to signs can be traced inward.

topics.headline: Plural construct signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a multiple field of signs already grammatically bound to Allah before the warrant denial arrives.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as genitive plural in construct with the divine name.

topics.headline: Signs as proof and verse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the contested field includes proof-bearing signs and revealed verses, while the local phrase remains Allah's signs in general.
topics.reason: The sign, proof, and verse range fits the plural construct, but no single branch should replace the whole local field.

topics.headline: Refuge pressure by root dispute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an irony between entering the sign-field polemically and the refuge-like pressure preserved by the derivational dispute.
topics.reason: The contested derivation can color the sign-field, but it cannot make refuge the selected lexical sense of the local plural.

topics.headline: Signs measured against missing warrant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that resistance to divine signs is measured against missing authority and traced inward to the perceiving subject, with 41:53 as a concrete contrast.
topics.reason: The rows connect the sign-field to 41:53 and to the local movement from divine ownership to denied warrant and interior motive.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as possessor of the signs
words.root_gloss_range: worship, dependence, deity, and disputed derivational pressure; here the named God owns the signs and later becomes refuge-source

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later refuge phrase where the divine name becomes refuge-source

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) completes the construct as the possessor of the signs, so the arena of dispute is not neutral. Valid warrant must come from the God whose signs are being contested, not from the disputants' interior pride; 12:40 sharpens that authorization contrast. The divine name also brackets the ayah's movement: here it owns the signs, and later in {{ar:بِٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:bi-allāhi}}) it becomes the refuge-source. The derivational pressure of worship and dependence survives as orientation, while the local grammar keeps the name as possessor.

topics.headline: Divine possessor of signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the disputed signs are not a neutral arena but signs belonging to the named God.
topics.reason: The word is the genitive possessor in the construct phrase for Allah's signs.

topics.headline: Named God as source of warrant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that valid authority must come from beyond the disputants' self-magnifying interior, with 12:40 sharpening the authorization contrast.
topics.reason: The divine-name derivation pressure survives as dependence and authorization, while the local grammar keeps Allah as possessor of the signs.

topics.headline: Name brackets dispute and refuge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same divine name moving from sign-owner to refuge-source, turning contested authority into protection.
topics.reason: The repeated divine name appears before the missing warrant and after the refuge command.

words.gloss_range: prepositional segment that turns lack of warrant into the circumstance of dispute

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: construct complement after the preposition marking lack

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches the dispute to {{ar:غَيْرِ}} ({{tr:ghayri}}), turning absence into the circumstance of their argument. The preposition can mark means or accompaniment, but here its means is inverted: their argumentative instrument is no authority. That makes the phrase more than a later criticism; lack travels with the dispute itself.

topics.headline: Means preposition inverted into absence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dispute is attached to absent means: its instrument is precisely non-authority.
topics.reason: The preposition attaches to the lack phrase and marks means or circumstance under absence.

words.gloss_range: construct noun specifying the relevant absent class: authority or warrant
words.root_gloss_range: otherness, alteration, exclusion, and displacement; here absence from the warranted class

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: authority noun governed by the lack construct

words.prose: {{ar:غَيْرِ}} ({{tr:ghayri}}) specifies what is absent by standing in construct with {{ar:سُلْطَٰنٍ}} ({{tr:sulṭānin}}). The word does not leave lack vague; it excludes their speech from the class of warranted authority. Its otherness and alteration field adds displacement from the valid warrant-track, while the local syntax selects absence of authority. Positioned between Allah's signs and authority, it begins the chain of no warrant, only pride, no attainment.

topics.headline: Specified absent class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lack is not vague; it specifies the missing class of proof-and-permission authority.
topics.reason: The noun stands in construct with the following authority word and functions as a standing circumstance of lack.

topics.headline: Outside the warrant track
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their polemic is displaced outside warranted speech, not merely weaker within it.
topics.reason: The root's otherness and alteration pressure fits the lack phrase, while local syntax selects absence of authority.

topics.headline: Gap in the negative chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the word sitting between signs and authority as part of a chain: no warrant, only pride, no attainment.
topics.reason: The row family tracks the local sequence of lack, restriction, and negated attainment.

words.gloss_range: indefinite warrant, proof, authority, and mandate denied under the lack phrase
words.root_gloss_range: authority, proof, dominance, support, and authorization; here any qualifying warrant is excluded

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: prepositional lack phrase under which authority is denied
arrival verb qualifying the missing authority
inner pride that replaces the denied external warrant

words.prose: {{ar:سُلْطَٰنٍ}} ({{tr:sulṭānin}}) names the missing credential as proof, authority, and mandate together. Its indefiniteness under {{ar:بِغَيْرِ}} ({{tr:bi-ghayri}}) denies any qualifying warrant, not merely a specific document. The dominance field gives the warrant force, but locally that force is absent. The following {{ar:أَتَىٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:atāhum}}) makes authority something that must arrive from beyond them, while {{ar:كِبْرٌ}} ({{tr:kibrun}}) appears as the counterfeit inner replacement.

topics.headline: Any qualifying warrant denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the indefinite noun under lack denies any qualifying warrant, not just one known certificate.
topics.reason: The word is an indefinite genitive complement of the lack construct and is further qualified by the arrival clause.

topics.headline: Proof with authoritative force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the missing warrant would carry proof, permission, and force, not bare information.
topics.reason: The proof-authority range fits the local noun, while dominance imagery remains supporting pressure under the warrant sense.

topics.headline: Authority must arrive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that authority is something received from beyond them, while pride appears as its counterfeit replacement.
topics.reason: The following perfect arrival verb and the contrast with 17:80 make support and authorization a missing received credential.

words.gloss_range: perfect arrival verb with the disputants as non-recipients of warrant
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arrival, bringing, and receipt; here nonarrival of authority to them is settled

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later non-attainment participle reversing the arrival movement

words.prose: {{ar:أَتَىٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:atāhum}}) says the authority has not come to them. The perfect verb and attached object make nonreceipt settled before the ongoing dispute continues. The root's coming and bringing pressure makes authority something that would have to enter applicable presence, not something they assert into existence. Later {{ar:بَٰلِغِيهِ}} ({{tr:bālighīhi}}) reverses the motion: authority does not reach them, and they do not reach the aim their pride pursues.

topics.headline: Settled nonarrival of authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the needed warrant has not reached the disputants before their ongoing argument.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect verb with the authority as subject and the disputants as attached object recipients.

topics.headline: Arrival as applicable receipt
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices authority as something that would have to come into applicable presence, not something asserted into existence.
topics.reason: Coming, bringing, and giving pressure supports receipt, while the local Form I verb selects arrival rather than causative giving.

topics.headline: Nonreceipt and nonattainment reverse each other
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the project failing from both directions: authority does not reach them, and they do not reach their aim.
topics.reason: The rows connect the local nonarrival to 53:23 and to the later non-attainment phrase.

words.gloss_range: negative particle paired with exception to restrict the motive

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: exception particle paired with this negative particle

words.prose: {{ar:إِن}} ({{tr:in}}) is negative here, not conditional. Paired with {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}), it strips away alternative explanations until one motive remains. That pivot moves the ayah from public argument about signs into the concealed interior where pride is lodged.

topics.headline: Negation through exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the apparent debate is redescribed by restriction: nothing is inside them except pride.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as negative here, paired with the following exception particle.

topics.headline: Pivot into the interior
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sentence turning from public polemic into the concealed motive-space.
topics.reason: The restrictive clause supplies the predicate content and is located inside their chests.

words.gloss_range: interior preposition locating the cause inside their chests

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: possessed chests governed as the interior motive-location
motive named after the preposed interior location

words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) locates the cause in {{ar:صُدُورِهِمْ}} ({{tr:ṣudūrihim}}), not in an evidentiary defect outside them. It keeps both container and motive-space pressure alive. Because the prepositional phrase comes before {{ar:كِبْرٌ}} ({{tr:kibrun}}), the reader enters the hidden location before the diagnosis is named. The repeated {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) moves from Allah's signs to their chests.

topics.headline: Motive located inside
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cause of the dispute is placed inside the disputants rather than in the evidence.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the possessed chests and marks interior location.

topics.headline: Location before named motive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices being led from the outer sign-field to the inner chamber before the word for pride appears.
topics.reason: The local order front-loads the prepositional phrase, and the repeated preposition contrasts signs and chests.

words.gloss_range: plural possessed chests as the shared hidden location of pride
words.root_gloss_range: breast, front, source, and issuing point; here the inward source of public disputation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: pride located in the possessed chests
final seeing title answering the hidden chest-location

words.prose: {{ar:صُدُورِهِمْ}} ({{tr:ṣudūrihim}}) is plural and possessed, distributing the hidden motive across the same disputing group. The chest is the grammatical location of {{ar:كِبْرٌ}} ({{tr:kibrun}}), not a new independent topic. The {{ar:ص د ر}} ({{tr:ṣ-d-r}}) field adds front and issuing-source pressure, so public dispute is felt as coming out from an inward front. The hidden chest-location prepares for {{ar:ٱلْبَصِيرُ}} ({{tr:al-baṣīru}}), with 114:5 as a concrete hidden-interior parallel.

topics.headline: Shared possessed interiority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices pride distributed across the same disputing group, not isolated in one person's mood.
topics.reason: The word is plural, possessed by the third masculine plural group, and governed as the location of the motive.

topics.headline: Chest as source-front
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices public argument issuing from an inward front, while the local noun still means chests as motive-location.
topics.reason: The source and front branches are coherent pressure, but local grammar selects the plural chest-location.

topics.headline: Hidden location answered by seeing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the concealed chest-location prepares the final seeing title, with 114:5 as a concrete hidden-interior parallel.
topics.reason: The rows connect the preposed chest phrase to the final divine seeing and to 114:5.

words.gloss_range: exceptive particle leaving pride as the only remainder
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) completes the restriction and leaves pride as the only expressed inward content. The particle turns a seemingly evidentiary debate into a diagnosis of motive. After a broad public dispute, the exception narrows many possible explanations to one cause.

topics.headline: Pride as sole remainder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the many possible explanations for argument compressed into one named cause: pride.
topics.reason: The exception particle completes the negative restriction and leaves pride as the only expressed inward content.

words.gloss_range: indefinite verbal noun naming pride as the interior quality
words.root_gloss_range: greatness, magnitude, and magnification; here narrowed to corrupted self-magnification

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: external warrant denied before pride appears as counterfeit

words.prose: {{ar:كِبْرٌ}} ({{tr:kibrun}}) names an indefinite inward quality rather than a formal doctrine or a measured claim. As a verbal noun, it abstracts arrogance from any single speech event and makes it the substance behind repeated disputation. The {{ar:ك ب ر}} ({{tr:k-b-r}}) scale of greatness is narrowed here to corrupted self-magnification against Allah's signs. The word follows denied external {{ar:سُلْطَٰن}} ({{tr:sulṭān}}), so pride functions as counterfeit warrant, and the next phrase immediately denies its attainment.

topics.headline: Unbounded inner quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices pride named as an inward quality or substance, not as a formal doctrine or one isolated speech act.
topics.reason: QAC marks an indefinite nominative verbal noun as the content of the restrictive clause.

topics.headline: Corrupted greatness scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the root of greatness turned into self-magnification against Allah's signs.
topics.reason: The greatness scale is active as corrupted self-enlargement, while local context prevents treating it as legitimate greatness.

topics.headline: Pride as counterfeit warrant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices denied external authority replaced by internal pride, with 7:146 and 40:48 clarifying arrogance as blocked reception.
topics.reason: The rows tie the local pride to same-surah arrogance, to 7:146, and to the immediate non-attainment verdict.

words.gloss_range: negative particle denying the whole attainment predicate

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: pride immediately followed by negated attainment

words.prose: {{ar:مَّا}} ({{tr:mā}}) negates the whole attainment predicate. It follows {{ar:كِبْرٌ}} ({{tr:kibrun}}) directly, making failure the consequence of self-magnifying motive. The point is not that one attempt fails, but that non-attainment characterizes their state.

topics.headline: Whole attainment predicate negated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices non-attainment stated as pride's immediate outcome, not a single failed attempt.
topics.reason: The negative particle introduces the nominal non-attainment clause following the pride diagnosis.

words.gloss_range: independent plural pronoun fixing the same group under non-attainment

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: reinforced non-attainment predicate following the pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:هُم}} ({{tr:hum}}) resumes the same disputing group explicitly. The independent pronoun makes the verdict pointed: they themselves are not attainors. By standing before {{ar:بِبَٰلِغِيهِ}} ({{tr:bi-bālighīhi}}), it prevents the accused group from changing after the chest diagnosis.

topics.headline: They themselves under denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same disputing group is explicitly held under the verdict: they themselves are not attainors.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun resumes the original plural referent as the subject before the reinforced predicate.

words.gloss_range: predicate preposition reinforcing the negated active participle

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: active participle reinforced by this predicate preposition

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) reinforces the negated predicate before {{ar:بَٰلِغِيهِ}} ({{tr:bālighīhi}}). The preposition makes non-attainment emphatic and relational, locking the verdict before the refuge command arrives. It also belongs to a three-part attachment sequence: absent authority, failed attainment, then valid refuge by Allah.

topics.headline: Reinforced non-attainment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the denial of attainment tightened before the command to seek refuge appears.
topics.reason: The predicate preposition intensifies the negated active participle in the nominal clause.

topics.headline: Failed and valid attachments
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sequence of attachment moving from absent authority to failed attainment to refuge by Allah.
topics.reason: The rows compare the three local prepositional attachments across lack, non-attainment, and refuge.

words.gloss_range: active participle with object suffix describing stable non-attainment
words.root_gloss_range: reaching, arriving, completing, maturing, and delivering; here pride's intended endpoint is denied

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier nonarrival verb reversed by the non-attainment phrase

words.prose: {{ar:بَٰلِغِيهِ}} ({{tr:bālighīhi}}) is an active participle with a suffix object, so the group is characterized as non-attainers of a pointed but rhetorically open target. The {{ar:ب ل غ}} ({{tr:b-l-gh}}) range of reaching, completion, and maturity turns the phrase into boundary failure: pride cannot cross into the authority, rank, or goal it seeks. The nominal phrasing freezes that failure as a status. Together with {{ar:أَتَىٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:atāhum}}), it denies both received warrant and achieved ambition.

topics.headline: Non-attainers of a pointed target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a stable characterization of the group as non-attainers, with the target pointed but not fully named.
topics.reason: The active participle in construct with an object suffix is the predicate under reinforced negation.

topics.headline: Boundary failure of pride
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices pride pressing toward a limit it cannot cross or mature into.
topics.reason: The reach, completion, and maturity range fits the active participle, while delivery language remains supporting pressure.

topics.headline: Arrival reversed into failed aim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices authority failing to reach them and their pride failing to reach its intended end.
topics.reason: The rows tie the non-attainment phrase to broader outcome language and to the earlier nonarrival verb.

words.gloss_range: consequential connector turning diagnosis into refuge-command
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) turns the diagnosis into immediate response. After pride and non-attainment, the ayah commands refuge rather than counter-polemic, refusing to answer unauthorized dispute on its own terms. The boundary with 40:55 matters: the movement from consequential patience to consequential refuge keeps the addressee disciplined under pressure.

topics.headline: Diagnosis becomes response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices analysis turning immediately into a protective speech act.
topics.reason: The connector marks the refuge command as the result or response to the preceding diagnosis.

topics.headline: Answer is refuge, not counter-argument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah refuses to mirror unauthorized polemic on its own terms.
topics.reason: The apodosis after the connector is a refuge command rather than a counter-disputation verb.

topics.headline: Parallel consequential commands
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from the command to be patient in 40:55 to the command to seek refuge in 40:56.
topics.reason: The boundary row identifies parallel consequential imperatives across 40:55 and 40:56.

words.gloss_range: Form X second-person singular imperative seeking refuge
words.root_gloss_range: seeking shelter, clinging for protection, and guarded attachment; here the commanded response to hostile pride
words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْتَعِذْ}} ({{tr:istaʿidh}}) pivots from third-person disputants to a second-person singular command. The response to their hidden pride is not escalation but seeking sheltering attachment. Form X makes the addressee ask for protection instead of manufacturing control, and the recited command is tightly bound to the preceding connector. The refuge root also recalls 16:98 and 40:27, placing refuge around contested recitation and hostile pressure.

topics.headline: They-to-you pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah turning from third-person diagnosis to a disciplined singular response.
topics.reason: QAC marks a second masculine singular imperative, and the boundary evidence keeps the addressed listener in view.

topics.headline: Protective attachment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices response as movement into sheltering attachment rather than escalation.
topics.reason: The refuge root image fits the local command, while the local phrase specifies refuge by Allah rather than generic shelter.

topics.headline: Form X request for protection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressee is told to seek protection rather than manufacture control.
topics.reason: QAC marks a Form X imperative, and the segmented connector is recited tightly with the command.

topics.headline: Refuge recurrence around signs

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) governs the divine name after the refuge command, making refuge a relation with Allah rather than abstract withdrawal. Its aid and attachment force means protection is sought by attachment to Him. After the earlier {{ar:بِغَيْرِ}} ({{tr:bi-ghayri}}) and {{ar:بِبَٰلِغِيهِ}} ({{tr:bi-bālighīhi}}), this final {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) supplies the valid attachment.

topics.headline: Refuge as relation with Allah

topics.headline: Valid attachment after failed attachments
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final preposition supplying the valid attachment after absent authority and denied attainment.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as the specific refuge-source
words.root_gloss_range: worship, dependence, deity, and derivational devotion pressure; here the named God is the shelter sought
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) names the refuge-source specifically. The addressee is not sent toward generic shelter or another debated sign, but toward the named God. The name carries worship and dependence pressure, reordering attachment away from self-magnification and toward divine protection. It also grounds the following hearing-seeing attributes, and 113:1 shows by contrast that this refuge formula names Allah directly after polemic over His signs.

topics.headline: Named refuge-source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices refuge directed to the named God, not to an abstract shelter or generic deity category.
topics.reason: The word is a definite proper name governed by the refuge preposition.

topics.headline: Dependence grounding attributes

topics.reason: The divine-name pressure survives as worship and dependence, while local grammar keeps Allah as the refuge complement and antecedent of the final attributes.

topics.headline: Repeated name transforms the axis

topics.reason: The rows provide the concrete refuge-formula comparison and the local repeated-name transformation.

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّهُۥ}} ({{tr:innahu}}) resumes Allah and gives the reason for seeking refuge. It opens a nominal explanation, so the basis for refuge is abiding divine identity, not a new event or detached praise. The fused emphatic particle and pronoun bind the final assertion to the same Allah named in refuge. This final certainty answers the first {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}): human dispute fails under divine perception.

topics.headline: Reason after the command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final attributes functioning as the reason for seeking refuge, not as detached praise.

topics.headline: Final certainty answers opening certainty

topics.reason: The rows explicitly connect the final emphatic frame with the opening assertion.

words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) delays the titles and focuses the predicate. The pronoun centers Allah alone as the hearer-seer behind the command, not the disputants and not their missing {{ar:سُلْطَٰن}} ({{tr:sulṭān}}). The final perception claim therefore lands as exclusive and emphatic rather than as a flat description.

topics.headline: Exclusive focus before titles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Allah alone centered as the hearer-seer, not the disputants or their missing warrant.
topics.reason: QAC marks an independent pronoun before the definite predicate pair, supporting separation or focus.

words.gloss_range: definite intensive title naming abiding divine hearing
words.root_gloss_range: hearing, receiving, attentive listening, and responsive audition; here divine hearing covers the voiced polemic

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: voiced disputation answered by the hearing title

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمِيعُ}} ({{tr:al-samīʿu}}) is a definite intensive predicate in the verbless final clause. Hearing is presented as an abiding divine quality, not a momentary reaction to this dispute. The {{ar:س م ع}} ({{tr:s-m-ʿ}}) field brings reception and attentive audition to the public speech of {{ar:يُجَٰدِلُونَ}} ({{tr:yujādilūna}}): every voiced argument is already heard. The title also joins a perception seal echoed at 58:1 and 40:20, while the paired seal maps hearing to speech and seeing to hidden motive.

topics.headline: Abiding hearing title

topics.headline: Voiced dispute already heard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices every voiced argument placed under divine reception, while seeing covers the hidden motive alongside it.
topics.reason: The hearing range supports total reception of speech, and the paired-title row maps hearing to dispute and seeing to inner cause.

topics.headline: Perception seal recurrence

words.gloss_range: definite intensive title naming abiding divine seeing and discernment
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceiving, insight, and clarification; here divine discernment reaches the hidden pride

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَصِيرُ}} ({{tr:al-baṣīru}}) completes the final paired title with {{ar:ٱلسَّمِيعُ}} ({{tr:al-samīʿu}}). Its definite intensive form makes seeing an abiding divine discernment, not eyesight alone. The {{ar:ب ص ر}} ({{tr:b-ṣ-r}}) range reaches the {{ar:كِبْرٌ}} ({{tr:kibrun}}) hidden in {{ar:صُدُورِهِمْ}} ({{tr:ṣudūrihim}}), making inward pride as exposed as outward speech. The hearing-seeing pair also has a concrete signs-and-perception parallel in 17:1.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction يُجَٰدِلُونَ ... بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمْ links disputing to the non-arrival of السلطان.
baseline_models.mechanism: Twisted, adversarial speech tries to overpower visible signs, but the verse subjects that speech to an arrival test: decisive authority must come to the speakers rather than be generated by their own verbal force.

activation_trace.role: Twisted contention supplies the speech mechanism: repeated verbal engagement seeks mastery over an opponent.
The visible sign supplies the object already available for recognition rather than invention.
Overpowering proof supplies the missing warrant whose absence verbal dominance cannot repair.
Arrival supplies the admissibility condition: the warrant would have had to reach them.

changed_reading.before: They argue about God's signs without proof.
changed_reading.after: Their argument has force only as verbal contest; it fails because no decisive warrant has arrived from beyond that contest.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence فِى صُدُورِهِمْ إِلَّا كِبْرٌ مَّا هُم بِبَٰلِغِيهِ places an unattained magnitude inside the breasts.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interior source magnifies an object until it appears great, then projects it as a destination. Disputation is therefore driven by an inward bid for greatness whose desired endpoint remains inaccessible.

activation_trace.role: The source from which actions issue locates the causal pressure of the dispute in the interior.
Magnifying something in the breast supplies the perceptual inflation that turns desire into a claim of greatness.
Self-exalting greatness supplies the social and vertical goal of the inflation.
Reaching an endpoint supplies the denied completion of the inward project.

changed_reading.before: Pride motivates the disputants, but they will not get what they want.
changed_reading.after: Their speech externalizes an inward act of self-magnification: it aims at a greatness configured as a destination, yet cannot complete the ascent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ redirects the addressee from the dispute to the One named ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Refuge transfers exposure from the opponents' verbal arena to divine protection. Hearing covers their uttered contest, while penetrating sight covers the interior magnitude that speech conceals.

activation_trace.role: Protective recourse supplies the move away from answering domination on its own terms.
Perception of voices supplies complete reception of the spoken dispute.
Penetrating insight supplies perception of the inward motive beyond audible claims.

changed_reading.before: Seek God's protection from hostile disputants because He knows what they do.
changed_reading.after: Refuge is a transfer to a protector whose hearing receives the public argument and whose sight penetrates its concealed interior cause.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah positively pairs Moses' signs with manifest overpowering proof, then states that even a messenger brings a sign only by divine permission. Against those controls, the focus disputants possess neither delivered proof nor authorization; their speech is self-issued authority.

activation_trace.role: Overpowering proof supplies the focus verse's explicitly absent warrant.
Arrival supplies the focus test that their claimed authority fails.
Visible signs supply the positive object paired with an actual warrant in Moses' mission.
Manifest overpowering proof supplies the positive counterpart to the focus disputants' missing authority.
The messenger's bringing of a sign confirms that valid evidence enters through a governed act of arrival.
The visible sign remains the delivered item rather than a product of the disputant's assertion.
Permission supplies the authorization gate even a messenger does not bypass.

structural_cues: 40:23 gives the positive pair of signs and manifest السلطان.
40:78 makes divine permission the condition for a messenger to bring a sign.
The focus negates both possession and arrival: no السلطان came to them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies positive delivery at 40:23, an authorization gate at 40:78, and negated arrival at 40:56; I infer that the disputants compensate by self-authorizing their speech. A live alternative is the narrower claim that they merely lack evidence, without an authorization contrast.

changed_reading.before: Their case is evidentially weak because they have no proof.
changed_reading.after: Their case is procedurally inverted: genuine signs and warrants are delivered under permission, while their contest manufactures authority from its own force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact disputing formula appears at 40:35 with an arrogant, domineering heart; Pharaoh immediately orders a lofty structure so that he may reach the ropes or links of heaven and inspect Moses' God. The links terminate in ruin, narratively staging the focus verse's inward greatness as an engineered but failed ascent.

activation_trace.role: Self-exalting greatness supplies the focus motive that seeks vertical realization.
Arrival at an endpoint supplies the completion explicitly denied in the focus.
The repeated twisted contention identifies Pharaoh's surrounding episode with the focus disputing mechanism.
Greatness and self-exaltation explicitly attach the repeated formula to the arrogant heart.
Pharaoh's stated wish to reach an endpoint converts the focus's abstract non-attainment into a voiced project.
A rope or connecting link supplies the imagined means by which the upward project would attain its target.
The repeated rope or link extends the attempted connection specifically toward the heavens.
Loss and ruin supply the terminal state of the supposedly elevating scheme.

structural_cues: 40:35 repeats nearly the entire focus opening and adds the arrogant domineering heart.
40:36 follows immediately with Pharaoh's أَبْلُغُ and a commanded tower.
40:37 repeats the heavenly links and closes Pharaoh's scheme with تَبَاب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact formula, immediate sequence, repeated reach vocabulary, links, and ruin; I infer that Pharaoh's construction is an enacted instance of the focus's blocked kibr. A live alternative is that the tower illustrates deception generally and does not determine the pronoun in بِبَٰلِغِيهِ.

changed_reading.before: The disputants will not attain the status imagined by their pride.
changed_reading.after: Their non-attainment is staged as Pharaoh's architecture of self-magnification: argument becomes an attempted climb toward epistemic and sovereign height, but its connecting means end in ruin.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, God knows what breasts conceal and judges decisively while hearing and seeing; Moses takes refuge from every arrogant denier; the believing man then hands his affair to God, who sees and protects him. The focus imperative compresses that sequence into a strategy: expose neither truth nor self to the opponent's dominance game, but hand the case to divine perception and protection.

Moses' recourse supplies the surah's explicit precedent for the focus imperative.

Returning one's affair to another in reliance supplies the procedural handoff enacted by the believing man.
Divine penetrating sight names the capacity to which the believing man entrusts his affair.
Repelling harm through protection supplies the narrated result after entrustment.

structural_cues: 40:19–20 moves from concealed breasts to decisive judgment and the same hearing-seeing pair.
40:27 pairs refuge directly with a self-exalting opponent.
40:44–45 sequences entrustment, divine sight, and protection.
40:56 recombines refuge, interior kibr, hearing, and sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent terms and the 40:44–45 sequence; I infer a functional arrow from entrustment and divine perception to protection, making refuge a handoff rather than mere retreat. A live alternative is that the epithets only reassure and the protection sequence is not a procedural model.

changed_reading.before: The addressee should withdraw from provocation and ask God for safety.
changed_reading.after: The addressee adopts the Moses-believer strategy: transfer the dispute and its hidden motive to the One who can judge, hear, see, and turn entrusted exposure into protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The verse immediately following the focus installs created cosmic scale as what is actually greater than human creation. Soon afterward, self-exaltation against worship terminates in abasement. The unattained kibr is thus a false measurement of creaturely scale as well as a moral attitude.

activation_trace.role: Magnitude opposed to smallness supplies the focus disputants' implicit scale claim.
Actual greater magnitude supplies the immediate cosmic correction to human self-enlargement.
Creative origination supplies the measured comparison between heavens and earth and humanity.
Self-exaltation supplies the behavioral expression of the focus's inward kibr.
Abasement and smallness reverse the self-elevating posture and supply its terminal scale.

structural_cues: 40:57 immediately answers focus kibr with a comparative أَكْبَرُ.
40:60 places يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ and دَاخِرِينَ in one causal sentence.
The sequence moves from inward magnitude to cosmic comparison to social abasement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, the repeated k-b-r root, a creation comparison, and an abasement outcome; I infer that 40:57 recalibrates the scale imagined in 40:56. A live alternative is that 40:57 only offers an independent resurrection proof.

changed_reading.before: They fail to gain the greatness they arrogantly seek.
changed_reading.after: Their very scale is false: cosmic creation exposes human smallness, and refusal to worship converts attempted elevation into abasement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later reaching is not rejected: created humans reach maturity and an appointed term, and provided carriers let them reach a need in their breasts. The focus therefore blocks the self-magnifying object of kibr, not reaching or inward desire as such; legitimate attainment is timed, provisioned, and carried rather than self-elevating.

A carrying vehicle supplies the external means that enables dependent attainment.

structural_cues: 40:67 repeats ب ل غ for created maturation and an appointed term.
40:80 repeats both ب ل غ and ص د ر but places حاجة, not كبر, in the interior.
40:79–80 supplies animals and ships as carrying means.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated reach-breast construction and explicit carriers; I infer a contrast between unsupported self-magnification and dependent, provided attainment. A live alternative is that 40:80 is an independent utility statement whose lexical echo does not revise 40:56.

changed_reading.before: The focus presents inward aspiration as a futile attempt to reach.
changed_reading.after: The focus condemns a specific unsupported object, kibr: needs in the breast can be reached when creaturely growth, timing, and carrying means are received rather than self-authored.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it materializes a branch image rather than deriving a lexical definition. It remains anchored because the exact disputing phrase returns at 40:69 immediately before collars, linked chains, and dragging at 40:71. Downstream prose should present it only as a whole-surah material echo, not as the meaning of ج د ل or as a hidden causal claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The tightly twisted branch of ج د ل in يُجَٰدِلُونَ can be carried as a material image without replacing the ordinary adversarial sense.

activation_trace.role: Tight twisting supplies the exploratory material image latent in the focus dispute.
The repeated tight-twisting root reactivates the image immediately before bodily restraint.
A collar that binds an organ supplies the first bodily externalization of verbal entanglement.
Connected links supply the chain form that visually answers tight twisting.
Dragging and extending the bound body supplies the terminal motion of the material echo.

changed_reading.before: Disputation is verbal entanglement directed against the signs.
changed_reading.after: The whole-surah sequence lets verbal twisting echo forward as linked restraint: the recurring contest is followed by bodies caught in collars and chains and dragged.

strongest_changes: The exact 40:35 recurrence and Pharaoh's أَبْلُغُ project at 40:36–37 turn unattained kibr into a failed architecture of ascent.
Moses' refuge at 40:27 and the believing man's entrustment-protection sequence at 40:44–45 make فَٱسْتَعِذْ a protective handoff to divine adjudication.
The positive warrant controls at 40:23 and 40:78 recast the disputants' problem as self-authorized speech, not merely weak evidence.
The reach-breast pairing at 40:80 distinguishes futile self-magnification from legitimate need attained through provided means.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet produced unusually dense recombinations of the focus roots: the opening formula recurs, Pharaoh voices the denied reaching, refuge is enacted and answered by protection, true scale immediately corrects kibr, and later ب ل غ plus ص د ر supplies a positive countermodel.
remaining_uncertainties: The Pharaoh sequence strongly stages non-attainment but need not exhaust the antecedent or scope of بِبَٰلِغِيهِ.
The 40:80 countermodel may be a deliberate contrast or a strong lexical echo without direct local argument.
The twist-to-chains model should remain exploratory and material, not lexicalized.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Argument is an attempted ascent that cannot reach its imagined scale.** `ج د ل/B001` gives tightly interlaced pressure, `ك ب ر/B001` greatness, and `ب ل غ/B001` reaching a limit, explicitly negated. I infer that disputation serves an internal desire for enlargement. The ayah reads the argument’s content as secondary to an impossible status project.
2. **Refuge answers argumentative pressure without entering its braid.** `ع و ذ/B001` supplies turning to protection. Its imperative follows the diagnosis, while hearing and sight guarantee access. I infer that protection permits non-capture by the dispute’s structure; the response is relocation of dependence, not counter-entanglement.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The scale comparison in 40:57 exposes the inner “greatness” as especially misplaced, while 40:69 shows disputation carrying its agents away.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **An inflated interior projects a stature its possessors cannot reach.** Lexically, `ك ب ر:B006` is "grandeur and self-magnification," `ب ل غ:B001` reaching a limit, and `ص د ر:B001` the chest as bodily front. Structurally, 40:54 locates receptive guidance in purified cores, whereas this ayah locates unsupported dispute in chests containing `كبر`; 40:57 immediately supplies a creation genuinely greater than human creation. Grandeur's role is an inward scale-image that disputation attempts to realize publicly. The packet gives contained magnitude and denied attainment; I infer that argument is the attempted vehicle for reaching imagined stature. The ayah reads as failed self-enlargement, corrected by refuge and by the next ayah's objective scale.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 40:69 repeats disputation as diversion and 40:71 supplies collars, making failed inward enlargement end in externally narrowed and controlled movement.

Allah'a sığınmak, tartışmanın örgüsüne yakalanmadan baskı alanının dışına çıkmayı sağlar; cevap karşı bir düğüm örmek değil, bağımlılığın yerini değiştirmektir.

error_profile.preserves: Yere atma eylemi, iki katılımcı ve yere düşmüş olma sonucu korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başka birini kuvvetle yere düşürdüğü geçişli eylem bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Etkileyen kişi, kuvvet uygulama ve yere düşürme sonucu korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eyleme uğrayan kişinin düşüp yerde kaldığı sonuç bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Düşme ve yerde bulunma sonucu korunur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal, bir kişiyi doğrudan yere atma ile onun yere serilmiş sonuç durumunu birbirine bağlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal güreşme, yenilme, ölüm sırasında topluca düşme ve düşürülmüş kişinin genel hali gibi daha geniş kullanımlara uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir insanın yere düşürülmesini ve yerde bulunmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal doğrudan yere atma eylemi ile onun sonucuna odaklanır; komşu dalın nedenleri ve kullanım alanları daha geniştir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yalnız daha geniş yere düşürme alanı, bu dalın doğrudan yere atma ve sonuç sınırını açıklığa kavuşturdu.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه جدل الإنسان وصرعه وانجداله وسقوطه وإلقاؤه على الجَدالة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجرد الخصومة اللفظية ولا الأرض من حيث هي أرض
branches.source_phrase_ar: طعنه فجدله أي رماه بالأرض (maqayis)؛ جدلته تجديلا أي صرعته (ayn)؛ طعنه فجدله أي رماه بالأرض فانجدل أي سقط (sihah)؛ جدلته فانجدل صريعا وهو مجدول (tahdhib)؛ الصراع وإسقاط الإنسان صاحبه على الجدالة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade, dalın gösterdiği şeyi doğrudan sert yer veya sert zemin olarak tanımlar. Geçici çerçeve, üzerine düşen kişiyi yalnız kullanım bağlamı sayıp zeminin kendisini çekirdekte tutar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yere düşme olayını değil, sertliğiyle nitelenen yerin veya zeminin kendisini adlandırır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız yalın adın sert yer anlamını verir ve yere serme kalıbından herhangi bir eylem anlamı aktarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yumuşak ya da gevşek olmayan, üzerinde durulan veya birinin düşebileceği sert yer yüzeyi ya da zemindir.

facets.statement: Gönderge, ayırt edici özelliği sertlik olan bir yer yüzeyi veya zemindir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak ve doğrudan tanımı, söz konusu adın sert bir yer yüzeyini göstermesidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yerin bir bölümü özellikle sert yüzeyiyle adlandırıldığında doğal ve eksiksiz karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yer göndergesi ve onu ayıran sertlik özelliği korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birinin düştüğü veya atıldığı yerin sert yüzeyini gösteren yönelme bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sert yer göndergesi bağlam içinde doğal çekimle korunur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal için sertlik yeterlidir ve tanım ayrıca kalınlık ya da düzlük şartı koymaz.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sertliğin yanında kalın, ağır veya düz olma gibi ek zemin özelliklerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da sert bir yer yüzeyini veya zemini gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yalın biçimde sert zemini adlandırır; komşu dal sertliği başka fiziksel yüzey özellikleriyle birlikte sınırlar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; sertliğe ek olarak düzlük ve kalınlık bildiren komşu, yalın sert zemin sınırını en iyi gösterdi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجَدالة اسما للأرض الصلبة وما يلقى عليها الصريع
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الصرع نفسه ولا الخصومة
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجدالة وهي الأرض وهي صلبة (maqayis)؛ الجدالة الأرض (sihah)؛ الجدالة اسم للأرض (tahdhib)؛ الجدالة وهي الأرض الصلبة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade, küçük bir akarsuyu veya havuza benzer bir yere su taşıyan küçük kolu ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Belirli büyük bir ırmaktan ayrılan kol ise bu çekirdeğin özel bir tanıklamasıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal büyük akarsuyu değil, küçük akarsuyu veya daha büyük bir sudan ayrılan küçük kolu adlandırır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın adların küçük akarsu anlamıyla sınırlıdır ve suyu yöneltme gibi eylem anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Kendi yatağında uzanan küçük bir akarsu veya daha büyük bir akarsudan ayrılıp su taşıyan küçük su koludur.

facets.statement: Gönderge, uzanan bir yatakta toplanmış suyu taşıyan küçük akarsudur.
Küçük akarsu, bir havuza su taşıyan kanal veya büyük bir akarsudan ayrılan kol olabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak tanım küçük akarsu üzerindedir; havuza su taşıyan yatak ve büyük bir akarsudan ayrılan kol bu alanın özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Küçük bir akarsuyu ve daha büyük bir sudan ayrılan küçük kolu doğal biçimde birlikte kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Küçük ölçek, akan su ve bağımsız yatak ya da ayrılan kol seçenekleri korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kendi küçük yatağında akan suyun bağımsız bir akarsu olarak anlatıldığı bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Küçük ölçekli akarsu ve akış yatağı korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir havuza yönelen veya daha büyük bir akarsudan ayrılan küçük su yatağı için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ana sudan ayrılan ya da bir yere su taşıyan küçük kol özelliği korunur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: küçük akarsu veya küçük su kanalı
büyük bir akarsudan ayrılan küçük kol

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal küçük akarsu veya küçük su kolu olmayı anlam sınırı olarak taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal daha bol akan nehri, suyun toprağı yararak yatak açmasını ve su düzeyine ilişkin kullanımları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir yatak içinde akan ve ilerleyen yüzey suyunu gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın ayırıcı yanı küçük ölçektir; komşu dal genel nehir alanına ve yatağın oluşumuna kadar genişler.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel nehir alanıyla karşılaştırma, bu dalın küçük ölçekli akarsu ve kol sınırını en açık biçimde gösterdi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجدول والجداول والجديل بمعنى النهر الصغير أو نهر الحوض وما يأخذ من الماء
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الحبل المجدول ولا الجدل في الكلام
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجدول نهر صغير وهو ممتد وماؤه أقوى في اجتماع أجزائه (maqayis)؛ الجديل نهر يأخذ من دجلة والجدول نهر الحوض ونحوه من الأنهار الصغار (ayn)؛ الجدول النهر الصغير (sihah)؛ الجدول نهر الحوض ونحو ذلك من الأنهار الصغار (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade iki bağlı fakat ayrı görünümü içerir: insanın uzuvları veya kol ve bacaklarının uzun kemikleri ile zayıflıktan kaynaklanmayan ince, sıkı ve düzgün beden yapısı. Geçici çerçeve ancak bu anatomik ad ile beden niteliği karıştırılmazsa kullanılabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: İnce yapılılık hastalıklı zayıflık değildir; ayrıca uzuv adı, bütün beden niteliğiyle özdeşleştirilmemelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın uzuv ve uzun kemik adlarını yalnız beden yapısını niteleyen kalıplardan açıkça ayırır.

concept_map.definition: İnsanın uzuvlarını, özellikle kol ve bacaklarının uzun kemiklerini adlandırır; beden nitelemesinde ise zayıflıktan değil doğal yapıdan gelen ince kemiklilik ile sıkı ve düzgün kuruluşu belirtir.

facets.statement: Yalın kullanım insan uzuvlarını veya kol ve bacakların uzun kemiklerini gösterir.
Beden nitelemesi, zayıflıktan kaynaklanmayan ince kemikli ve narin yapıyı anlatır.
Olumlu nitelemede uzuvların ve bedenin sıkı, düzgün ve iyi kurulmuş olması öne çıkar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar uzuv ve uzun kemik adını, doğal olarak ince kemikli fakat zayıf olmayan beden yapısı ve düzgün kuruluş nitelemesiyle birlikte verir.

concept_gloss.text: uzun uzuvlar ve ince, sıkı beden yapısı
concept_gloss.applicability: Anatomik uzuv adını ve ona dayanan ince kemikli fakat sağlam beden niteliğini birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Uzuvlar, uzun kemikler, doğal ince yapı ve zayıflık dışındaki sağlamlık korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün bedenin belirli uzuvlarını veya onların uzun kemiklerini adlandırdığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Anatomik kapsam ve kol ile bacaklara özgü uzun kemik göndergesi korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin hastalıklı zayıflık olmadan narin ve sıkı bedenli olduğunu anlatan bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İnce kemiklilik, sıkı kuruluş ve zayıflık dışındaki doğal yapı korunur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir uzuv veya uzun uzuv kemiği
uzuvlar veya kol ve bacakların uzun kemikleri

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal uzuv ve uzun kemik adlarını içerir ve ince yapının zayıflıktan gelmediğini özellikle belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bütün bedeni ipe benzer biçimde uzamış, sarılmış veya düzgünce çekilmiş görünüşüyle betimler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da ince, uzun ve derli toplu bir insan bedenini olumlu biçimde niteleyebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal anatomik uzuvları da kapsar ve doğal ince kemikliliği sınırlar; komşu dal ise bütün bedenin uzamış görünüşüne odaklanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; ince ve düzgün bütün beden komşusu, bu dalın uzuv adı ile doğal ince kemiklilik birleşimini en iyi ayırdı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه جدول الإنسان بمعنى الأعضاء أو قصب اليدين والرجلين والمجدول من الخلق القضيف اللطيف القصب
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الهزال ولا الخصومة ولا النهر
branches.source_phrase_ar: رجل مجدول إذا كان قضيف الخلقة من غير هزال والجدول الأعضاء واحدها جدل (maqayis)؛ جدول الإنسان قصب اليدين والرجلين وإنسان مجدول الخلق أي لطيف القصب (ayn)؛ جارية مجدولة الخلق والمجدول القضيف لا من هزال (sihah)؛ حسن الجدل إذا كان حسن أسر الخلق وجدول الإنسان قصب اليدين والرجلين ورجل مجدول الخلق لطيف القصب (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade, oğlanın ve genç devenin güçlenmesini, başaktaki tanenin kuvvetlenmesini ve avcı kuşun sağlam yapısını ortak alanda toplar. Yeşil ve yuvarlak hurma ise tam sertleşmeden önceki gelişim aşamasıdır; bu yüzden dal bütünü yalnız tam sertlik diye tanımlanamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek gelişimsel güçlenme ve sağlam yapıdır; yeşil hurma kullanımı tam olgunluk veya tam sertlik bildirmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, canlı ve bitkilere bağlı kalıplardaki güçlenmeyi aşama adları ile sağlam yapılı kuş adından ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir canlının ya da bitki ürününün gelişirken güç kazanmasını ve belirli bir aşamaya erişmesini, ayrıca bir canlının yapıca güçlü ve sağlam olmasını anlatır. Yeşil hurma kullanımında aşama, tam sertleşmeden önceki yuvarlaklaşmış durumdur.

facets.statement: Canlı veya bitki ürünü gelişim içinde güçlenir, sıkılaşır ya da daha ileri bir aşamaya ulaşır.
Genç deve, annesiyle yürüyebildiği ilk güçlenme basamağının üstündeki gelişim aşamasına ulaşır.
Hurma, yeşil ve yuvarlak olduğu fakat henüz tam sertleşmediği erken aşamada özel bir ad alır.
Avcı kuş, güçlü oluşu ve sağlam kurulmuş bedeni bakımından nitelenir veya adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak alan gelişimde güç kazanma ve sağlam yapıdır; genç deve ile yeşil hurma belirli aşamaları, avcı kuş ise kalıcı beden gücünü gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: gelişimde güçlenme veya sağlam yapılı olma
concept_gloss.applicability: Gelişen canlı ve ürünlerde güç kazanmayı, ayrıca bir canlının güçlü beden yapısını birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Gelişim aşaması, güç kazanma, erken ürün durumu ve sağlam beden niteliği korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir oğlanın, genç hayvanın veya başaktaki tanenin gelişerek kuvvetlendiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gelişim süreci ve bu süreçte güç kazanma korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hurma tanesinin yeşil ve yuvarlak olup henüz tam sertleşmediği özel aşamayı anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Ürünün yeşilliği, yuvarlaklığı ve tam sertleşme öncesindeki aşaması korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Avcı kuşun güçlü ve sıkı kurulmuş beden yapısıyla adlandırıldığı bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kuşun gücü ve sağlam beden yapısı korunur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: rasih aşamasını geçip annesiyle yürüme eşiğinin üstüne çıkmış genç deve
yeşillenip yuvarlaklaşmış, henüz tam sertleşmemiş hurma
güçlü ve sağlam yapılı avcı kuş

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal güçlenmeyi oğlan, genç deve, başaktaki tane ve erken hurma gibi belirli gelişim aşamalarına ve avcı kuşa bağlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, gelişim aşaması şartı olmadan insan, binek hayvanı ve başka nesnelerde dayanma gücü ile genel sertliği kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da güç, sıkılık ve sağlamlık özelliklerinin bulunduğu anlam alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda güç çoğunlukla belirli bir gelişim aşamasına veya sağlam yapılı avcı kuşa bağlıdır; komşu dal genel dayanıklılık niteliğidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel dayanıklılık komşusu, bu dalın gelişim aşamalarına ve belirli canlı türlerine bağlı kapsamını en iyi gösterdi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه اشتداد الغلام وقوة الفصيل وحب السنبل والبلح الأخضر والأجدل من الصقور لقوة بنيته
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس رجل أحدل المنكب ولا الخصومة
branches.source_phrase_ar: غلام جادل إذا اشتد وجدل الحب في سنبله قوي والأجدل الصقر سمي بذلك لقوته (maqayis)؛ الأجدل من صفة الصقر (ayn)؛ الجادل من ولد الناقة فوق الراشح وهو الذي قوي ومشى مع أمه والجدال البلح إذا اخضر واستدار قبل أن يشتد (sihah)؛ إذا قوي الفصيل ومشى فهو راشح فإذا ارتفع عن الراشح فهو جادل والأجادل الصقور (tahdhib)؛ الأجدل الصقر المحكم البنية (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade aynı söz biçiminde yan, tutulan yol veya ilk durum anlamlarını ve ayrıca kabile anlamını tanıklar. Geçici çerçeve bu anlamları doğru sıralar; ancak kabile kullanımı yön ve durum çekirdeğinin sıradan bir örneği gibi sunulmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yan, yol ve önceki durum bir kullanım kümesidir; kabile anlamı aynı dal içinde ayrı bir kaynak çeşidi olarak korunur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın yan ve kabile anlamlarını durum bildiren kalıplardan ve mensubiyet türevlerinden ayrı gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimsenin veya topluluğun bulunduğu yanını, tuttuğu yolu ya da önceki durumunu anlatır; aynı söz biçimi ayrıca bir kabileyi veya ona bağlı topluluğu adlandırır.

facets.statement: Bir kimsenin ya da topluluğun bulunduğu yan, izlediği yol veya sürdürdüğü önceki durum gösterilir.
Aynı söz biçimi, insanlardan oluşan bir kabileyi veya ona bağlı topluluğu da adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yan, yol ve ilk durum anlamlarını bir kullanım kümesinde verirken kabile anlamını aynı söz biçiminin ayrı bir ad kullanımı olarak tanıklar.

concept_gloss.text: yan, tutulan yol, ilk durum veya kabile
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın yön ve durum kümesini kabile adı kullanımıyla karıştırmadan en kısa biçimde birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Yan, izlenen yol, önceki durum ve ayrı kabile anlamlarının tümü korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin kendi yönünü, tutumunu veya gidiş biçimini sürdürdüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiye özgü yön ve izlenen yol anlamı korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi veya topluluğun daha önceki halini sürdürdüğünü anlatan bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İlk ya da önceki durumun devam etmesi korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz biçiminin yön veya durum değil, insan topluluğu adı olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İnsanlardan oluşan kabile göndergesi korunur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yan, tutulan yol veya ilk durum

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yan ve ilk durum anlamlarını taşır, ayrıca ayrı bir kabile adı kullanımını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal genel yaşam yolunu, iyi veya kötü gidişi ve bir şeyin eski biçimine dönmesini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir kimsenin izlediği yolu veya içinde bulunduğu durumu anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirli bir yan, kişinin kendi yolu ya da sürdürülen ilk durumla sınırlıdır ve kabile anlamına da sahiptir; komşu dal genel gidiş biçimidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel gidiş ve durum komşusu, yön ve ilk durum kümesini ayrı kabile kullanımından ayırmaya en çok yardımcı oldu.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الفتل الحسي ولا الجدال في الخصومة
branches.source_phrase_ar: جديلة قبيلة (ayn)؛ الجديلة الشاكلة والجديلة القبيلة والناحية (sihah)؛ القوم على جديلة أمرهم أي على حالهم الأول وفلان على جديلته كقولك على ناحيته وجديلة طيئ قبيلة (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade yüksek veya çevreye bakan sarayı, sağlam kurulmuş yapıyı ve yapıyı sağlamlaştırma eylemini açıkça destekler. Geçici çerçeve, yapı adı ile eylemi birbirine karıştırmadan korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hem sağlam ve yüksek yapı adını hem yalnız yapı nesnesine bağlı sağlamlaştırma eylemini içerir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın yüksek ve sağlam yapı adlarını yalnız yapı sözüyle kurulan sağlamlaştırma kalıbından ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Yüksek, çevreye bakan veya sağlam biçimde kurulmuş saray türü yapıdır; yapıya bağlı eylem kullanımında ise parçalarını sağlam biçimde birleştirip yapıyı pekiştirmektir.

facets.statement: Ad olarak yüksek, çevreye bakan ya da sağlam kurulmuş saray türü bir yapıyı gösterir.
Yapı sözüyle kurulan eylem, yapının parçalarını sağlamlaştırıp kuruluşunu pekiştirmeyi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yüksek veya sağlam saray türü yapı adında birleşir; ortak ifade ayrıca yapıyı sağlam kurma eylemini bu adla ilişkilendirir.

concept_gloss.text: sağlam yüksek yapı ve yapıyı pekiştirme
concept_gloss.applicability: Saray türü sağlam yüksek yapıyı ve yalnız yapı bağlamındaki sağlamlaştırma eylemini birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Yüksek ve sağlam yapı göndergesi ile yapıyı pekiştirme eylemi korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün çevreye bakan veya sağlam kurulmuş saray türü yapıyı adlandırdığı bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yapının saray türü, yüksek ve sağlam olması korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir yapının parçalarını sağlam bir kuruluş oluşturacak biçimde birleştirme eyleminde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yapı nesnesi, sağlam birleştirme işlemi ve pekiştirme sonucu korunur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sağlam kuruluşu öne çıkarır ve ayrıca yapıyı pekiştirme eylemini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal tek başına duran, süslü veya genel olarak yüksek her türlü yapıyı kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yüksek bir sarayı veya çevresine göre yükselen büyük bir yapıyı gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda sağlam kurulmuş olma ve yapıyı pekiştirme bağı belirgindir; komşu dalın ayırıcı yönü genel yükseklik ve bağımsız yapı görünümüdür.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel yüksek yapı komşusu, bu dalın sağlam kuruluş ve yapıyı pekiştirme özelliklerini en açık biçimde ayırdı.
